title: CSV export UTF-8 encoding
symptoms: Accented characters corrupted in CSV exports
workaround: Use the ?encoding=utf-8-sig option in the export URL

title: Python 3.12 incompatibility
workaround: Stay on Python 3.10 or 3.11 until the fix is released

title: Export timeout on large datasets
workaround: Use the asynchronous export /api/v2/export/async with polling

title: SSO SAML audience mismatch
symptoms: invalid_audience during Okta/Azure AD SSO login
workaround: Update the Entity ID in the SAML config to nexus://prod

title: TOTP clock drift
symptoms: 2FA code rejected even though it is correct
workaround: Synchronize the server clock (ntpdate) — tolerance reduced to ±15s in 3.0

title: ImportError DataConnector
workaround: Remplacer par 'from nexus.connectors import DataConnector' (refactoring v3)

title: Alert emails not sent
symptoms: Alerts configured but emails not received
workaround: Check SMTP_TLS=true in .env — behavior change in v3

title: Blank dashboard after login
symptoms: TypeError: undefined is not a function en console JS
workaround: Clear the browser cache and localStorage — session migration issue

title: v2→v3 migration fails at step 3/7
workaround: Run 'nexus db cleanup-legacy' before the migration

title: Cursor pagination looping
symptoms: The pagination cursor returns the same results after page 2
workaround: Use offset+limit until the fix is released, or upgrade to v3.1.1

title: Form custom fields lost
symptoms: Custom fields lost after F5 without saving
workaround: Enable autosave in Settings > Forms > AutosaveInterval

title: Nightly backup failing since 3.1.0
symptoms: connection refused :5433 in the backup logs

title: Duplicate webhook events
symptoms: Events sent 2-3x for a single event
